newWholeDecision.rationale: AUTHOR targeted source correction: actual B12-EA.3.1/GA.3.1 constructs a phylogenetic cladogram from molecular features. This cannot evidence a human-family inheritance pedigree. The erroneous550→440 edge is removed; correct f368→440 family-inheritance evidence is retained. The literal cladogram obligation remains and needs an independently reviewed appropriate canonical mapping; no source-union clearance.
